ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the potential corruption and obstruction of justice in Minnesota, including the DOJ's investigation into top Democrats and Rep. Ilhan Omar's finances.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate potential financial improprieties
questions: What are the potential financial improprieties in Minnesota?
How deep does the corruption go?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant corruption and obstruction of justice in Minnesota. By following the money and investigating potential financial improprieties, we may uncover a larger pattern of corruption.
